title: cascivo
description: cascivo components for A2UI v0.9. Event props (on*) take an A2UI Action; `text` is a component’s text content. Render with fromA2UI + <CascivoView> from @cascivo/render.

Alert.description: Highlights a short, important message inline

AutoGrid.description: Media-query-free responsive grid — columns auto-fill based on available space.

Avatar.description: Displays a user image with initials fallback

Badge.description: Small status label or category indicator

Breadcrumb.description: Shows the current page location within a navigation hierarchy

Center.description: Horizontally centered container with a configurable max-width.

Checkbox.description: Binary toggle for forms, with indeterminate support

CheckboxCard.description: Multi-selectable card backed by a native checkbox. Use multiple independent CheckboxCards for multi-select scenarios.

Columns.description: Equal-width multi-column layout that collapses to single column on narrow viewports.

Combobox.description: Filterable single-select with an animated custom listbox, built on the dropdown open/close machine

CommandMenu.description: Cmd+K command palette with fuzzy search over grouped commands

DataTable.description: Signal-driven data table with client/server sort, filter, pagination, multi-selection, expandable rows, and CSS content-visibility row containment for large datasets

DatePicker.description: An accessible date-picker with a calendar popover.

Dropdown.description: Menu of actions revealed from a trigger

EmptyState.description: Placeholder for views that have no data to display

FileUploader.description: Drag-and-drop file upload zone with file list and status indicators.

Flex.description: Flex layout primitive for vertical or horizontal stacking with gap control. ⚠ Unlike CSS `flex-direction`, `direction` defaults to `vertical` — pass `direction="horizontal"` for a row.

Form.description: Typed signal-based form store (createForm/useForm) with sync/async validation and a thin Form element wrapper

Grid.description: CSS grid layout primitive with responsive column collapsing. Establishes its own containment, so responsive `cols` adapt to the grid’s own slot width with no wrapper or container ancestor required.

GridItem.description: One cell of a Grid, spanning columns and rows.

Header.description: App top bar with brand, primary navigation links, and an actions slot

HeaderPanel.description: Non-modal panel anchored below the shell header at the inline-end edge — hosts notifications, app switcher, user settings

Input.description: Text input field with optional label, hint, and error state

InputGroup.description: Prefix/suffix addon wrapper for Input; InputGroupAddon renders inline icons/units inside the field border; ButtonGroup collapses adjacent button borders

Kbd.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut

LargeTitleHeader.description: Scrolling region whose large title collapses into a compact sticky bar as it scrolls

Link.description: Styled anchor for navigation, standalone or inline within prose

Modal.description: Accessible dialog overlay using native <dialog> element

NumberInput.description: Numeric input with stepper buttons, clamping, precision, and locale formatting

OverflowMenu.description: Kebab icon button revealing a menu of row-level actions

Pagination.description: Controls for navigating paged data sets, with page size selection

ProgressBar.description: Shows determinate or indeterminate progress of a task

ProgressIndicator.description: Shows progress through the steps of a multi-step flow

Radio.description: Single choice from a set, grouped with RadioGroup

RadioCard.description: Selectable card backed by a native radio input. Use RadioCardGroup for single-select groups.

RadioCardGroup.description: Groups RadioCard options into one single-choice field.

Search.description: Search input with debounced search callback and clear button

Select.description: Native select menu styled to match the design system

Separator.description: Visual or semantic divider between content

ShellHeader.description: Console application header: brand with prefix, dropdown nav menus, global icon actions, hamburger, skip-to-content

SideNav.description: Collapsible sidebar navigation with optional icons and one level of grouping

Skeleton.description: Animated loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of pending content

Slider.description: Range input for selecting a value within bounds

Spacer.description: Fixed-height spacing block using design token steps.

Switcher.description: Always-visible app/product switcher LIST — every entry is rendered at once, it does not collapse. Lives inside HeaderPanel; renders links with an active indicator and optional dividers. For a collapsed trigger with a menu, use Dropdown.

Tabs.description: Switch between related panels of content

Tag.description: Compact chip for labeling, categorizing, or filtering content

Textarea.description: Multi-line text input with optional label, hint, and error state

TimePicker.description: Native time input wrapper with label, hint, error, and size variants

Toast.description: Transient notification surfaced via the useToast hook

Toggle.description: On/off switch built as an accessible button

Tooltip.description: Contextual label shown on hover or focus

theme.description: cascivo themes are CSS: set data-theme on the host element instead.
